verdict.rationale: smolagents ships CLI utilities (`smolagent`, `webagent`) explicitly described as letting users run agents from the terminal without boilerplate, which supports headless execution for verification purposes. However, there is no dedicated worked example showing an agent verifying code it just built, nor independent hands-on confirmation of this CLI workflow. Missing for 10: a concrete example/tutorial of headless CLI verification loop, and independent corroboration of the CLI tools working as described.
